exercises.en: Supine hip abduction
steps_en: Lie on your back, legs straight.
Slide one leg out to the side.
Bring it back slowly.

exercises.en: Short arc quad

Hold 2 s and lower.

exercises.en: Wall push-up

Bend your elbows and bring your chest to the wall.
Push back.

Lift one straight leg out to the side.
Lower slowly, body upright.

Bend one knee, heel toward the buttock.

Squeeze the ball for 5 seconds.

Straighten one knee and pull toes up.
Hold 2 s and lower slowly.

Lower slowly.

Lean toward the wall.

Lower slowly.

Lower slowly.

Lower slowly.

Small balance corrections.

Lower slowly.

Return slowly.

exercises.en: Shoulder internal rotation with a band, arm out to the side at 90
steps_en: Arm out at shoulder height, band from behind.
Turn the forearm forward.
Return slowly.

exercises.en: Diagonal pull down across the body with a band (PNF D2 extension)
steps_en: Both hands up to one side holding the band.
Pull one hand down across to the other hip.
Return slowly.

exercises.en: Diagonal pull up and out with a band under the opposite foot
steps_en: Stand on the band, hand near the opposite hip.
Pull up and out across the body.
Return slowly.

exercises.en: Squat with arms overhead against a band anchored low in front
steps_en: Arms up, band anchored low in front.
Squat, keeping the arms up.
Stand up.

exercises.en: Row and shoulder external rotation with a band
steps_en: Hold the band in front at waist height.
Pull the elbows out to shoulder height.
Turn the forearms up, then return.

exercises.en: Seated trunk rotation against a band anchored to the side
steps_en: Sit, arms forward, band anchored to the side.
Turn the trunk away from the band.
Return slowly.

exercises.en: Seated diagonal pull up and out with a band
steps_en: Sit, one hand on the thigh holding the band.
Pull the other arm up and out.
Return slowly.

exercises.en: Oblique crunch pulling a band anchored behind the head
steps_en: Lie on your back, band behind the head in one hand.
Curl up towards the opposite knee.
Lower slowly.

exercises.en: Hamstring curl against a band, lying on the stomach
steps_en: Lie on your stomach, band on the ankle.
Bend the knee to 90 degrees.
Lower slowly.

exercises.en: Seated knee flexion against a band anchored in front
steps_en: Sit, band from the ankle to the front.
Pull the heel back under the chair.
Return slowly.

exercises.en: Terminal knee extension with a band behind the knee
steps_en: Band behind the knee, anchored in front.
Bend the knee a little.
Straighten it fully.

exercises.en: Both shoulders external rotation with a band, sitting on an exercise ball
steps_en: Sit on the ball, elbows bent at your sides.
Pull the hands apart.
Return slowly.

exercises.en: Shoulder flexion to 90 holding a band in external rotation, sitting on an exercise ball
steps_en: Sit on the ball, hands apart on the band.
Lift the arms forward to shoulder height.
Lower slowly.

exercises.en: Elbow curl holding a stick, standing
steps_en: Hold a stick, palms up, arms down.
Bend the elbows, bringing the stick up.
Lower it slowly.

exercises.en: Shoulder flexion holding a stick, standing
steps_en: Hold a stick in front of the thighs.
Raise it overhead, elbows straight.
Lower it slowly.

exercises.en: Raise a stick to shoulder height, standing
steps_en: Hold a stick in front of the thighs.
Raise it to shoulder height.
Lower it slowly.

exercises.en: Lift a stick from the chest to overhead, standing
steps_en: Hold a stick at the chest.
Push it up overhead.
Bring it back to the chest.

exercises.en: Raise a stick overhead with a wide grip, standing
steps_en: Hold a stick wide in front of the thighs.
Raise it overhead in a wide arc.
Lower it slowly.

exercises.en: Assisted shoulder abduction with a stick, standing
steps_en: Hold the end of a stick in the hand to work.
Push with the other hand, raising the arm out to the side.
Lower it slowly.

exercises.en: Shoulder extension with a stick behind the back, standing
steps_en: Hold a stick behind you.
Lift it back, away from the body.
Lower it slowly.

exercises.en: Assisted shoulder internal rotation with a stick behind the back
steps_en: Stick behind the back: one hand up, one hand low.
Pull up with the top hand.
Let it slide down.

exercises.en: Assisted shoulder external rotation with a stick, elbows at the sides
steps_en: Elbows bent at your sides, stick in both hands.
Push the stick to one side, turning the other arm out.
Return slowly.

exercises.en: Elbow curl with a stick, lying on the back
steps_en: Lie on your back, stick held up to the ceiling.
Bend the elbows, bringing the stick to the chest.
Push it back up.

exercises.en: Shoulder flexion with a stick, lying on the back
steps_en: Lie on your back, stick on the thighs.
Raise it up and back overhead.
Bring it back slowly.

exercises.en: Upper trunk rotation holding a stick up, lying on the back
steps_en: Lie on your back, stick held up.
Turn the upper trunk and arms to one side.
Return and switch.

exercises.en: Shoulder internal rotators stretch with a stick, arm out at 90, lying on the back
steps_en: Lie on your back, arm out, elbow at 90.
Push the stick, turning the forearm back.
Hold, then return.

exercises.en: Assisted shoulder external rotation with a stick, elbows at the sides, lying on the back
steps_en: Lie on your back, elbows bent at your sides.
Push the stick, turning one forearm out.
Return slowly.

exercises.en: Trunk rotation holding a stick, elbows bent, sitting on an exercise ball
steps_en: Sit on the ball, elbows bent, stick in the hands.
Turn the trunk to one side.
Return and switch.

exercises.en: Tilt a stick held out in front, sitting on an exercise ball
steps_en: Sit on the ball, stick held out in front.
Tilt the stick, one end up.
Level it and switch.

exercises.en: Back and latissimus stretch, hands on a stick, sitting
steps_en: Sit, hands on top of a stick on the floor.
Lean forward, head between the arms.
Sit back up slowly.

exercises.en: Stir circles with a stick planted on the floor, sitting
steps_en: Sit, hands on a stick planted on the floor.
Lean around in a circle.
Switch direction.

exercises.en: Thoracic extension over a stick hooked behind the back, sitting
steps_en: Sit, stick hooked behind the back in the elbows.
Lean back and look up.
Return slowly.

exercises.en: Assisted shoulder flexion with a vertical stick, sitting
steps_en: Sit, stick upright, the arm to work on top.
Push up with the other hand.
Lower it slowly.

exercises.en: Lunge with trunk rotation holding a stick in front
steps_en: Stand, stick held in front.
Lunge and turn to the front leg.
Come back up.

exercises.en: Soleus stretch in half kneeling, holding a stick for balance
steps_en: Half kneel, hand on a stick for balance.
Move the front knee forward, heel down.
Hold, then return.

exercises.en: Deep squat on a balance board, arms forward
steps_en: Stand on the board, arms forward.
Squat deep, keeping balance.
Stand up slowly.

exercises.en: Squat on a wobble cushion, arms forward
steps_en: Stand on the cushion, feet apart.
Squat to 90 degrees, arms forward.
Stand up slowly.

exercises.en: Squat on a BOSU, arms forward
steps_en: Stand on the BOSU dome.
Squat, arms forward for balance.
Stand up slowly.

exercises.en: Squat on a BOSU turning the trunk, holding a ball
steps_en: Stand on the BOSU holding a ball out in front.
Squat and turn to each side.
Stand up.

exercises.en: Shoulder flexion standing on a balance board
steps_en: Stand on the board, feet together.
Raise both arms up to the ears.
Lower them slowly.

exercises.en: Bend forward standing on a balance board
steps_en: Stand on the board.
Bend forward, hands towards the feet.
Come back up slowly.

exercises.en: Lean back, hands on the lower back, standing on a balance board
steps_en: Stand on the board, hands on the lower back.
Lean back gently, looking up.
Come back slowly.

exercises.en: Side bend standing on a balance board
steps_en: Stand on the board, feet together.
Bend to one side, other arm overhead.
Return and switch.

exercises.en: Single leg hops forward and back over a line on the floor
steps_en: Stand on one leg behind a line.
Hop forward over the line.
Hop back.

exercises.en: Step and tap marks on the floor, holding a chair at the side
steps_en: Stand holding a chair at your side.
Tap the marks in front, diagonal and to the side.
Bring the foot back each time.

exercises.en: Calf stretch pulling a towel round the foot, sitting with legs straight
steps_en: Sit, legs straight, towel round one foot.
Pull the towel, toes towards you.
Hold, then relax.

exercises.en: Soleus stretch with a towel, knee bent over a roll, sitting
steps_en: Sit, knee bent over a roll, towel round the foot.
Pull the towel, toes towards you.
Hold, then relax.

exercises.en: Assisted knee bend pulling a towel round the foot, lying on the back
steps_en: Lie on your back, towel round one foot.
Pull the towel, sliding the heel up.
Straighten the leg slowly.

exercises.en: Calf stretch with the toes of one foot up on a block, standing
steps_en: Stand, toes of one foot on a block, heel down.
Lean forward, knee straight.
Hold, then return.

exercises.en: Calf stretch with the toes of both feet up on a roll, standing
steps_en: Stand, toes of both feet on a roll, heels down.
Lean forward, knees straight.
Hold, then return.

exercises.en: Walk along an agility ladder, one foot in each square
steps_en: Stand at the start of the ladder.
Walk forward, one foot in each square.
Keep looking ahead.

exercises.en: Walk along an agility ladder looking down at the feet
steps_en: Stand at the start of the ladder.
Walk forward, one foot in each square.
Watch where the feet land.

exercises.en: Step both feet into each square of an agility ladder
steps_en: Face along the ladder.
Step one foot into the square, then the other.
Move on square by square.

exercises.en: Quick steps into each square of an agility ladder, same leg leading
steps_en: Face along the ladder, hands ready.
Quick steps: both feet into each square.
Lead with the same leg.

exercises.en: Step sideways into each square of an agility ladder
steps_en: Stand side-on to the ladder.
Step sideways into the square, bring the other foot.
Move on square by square.

exercises.en: Two-footed jumps into each square of an agility ladder
steps_en: Feet together, hands on the hips.
Jump with both feet into the next square.
Land softly and go on.

exercises.en: Gait training with a walker: push it forward, step with one leg, bring the other to it
steps_en: Stand in the walker, hands on the grips.
Push it forward, step with the weak leg.
Bring the other foot next to it.

exercises.en: Gait training with a walker, stepping through
steps_en: Stand in the walker, hands on the grips.
Walk on, one foot past the other.
Keep the walker moving ahead.

exercises.en: Gait training with a cane: cane forward, step to it with the weak leg, bring the other leg
steps_en: Cane in the hand opposite the weak leg.
Cane forward, then step the weak leg to it.
Bring the strong leg to the other.

exercises.en: Gait training with a cane, stepping through, heel first
steps_en: Cane in the hand opposite the weak leg.
Cane and weak leg forward together.
Step the strong leg past them, heel first.

exercises.en: Balance standing in a walker, letting go one hand at a time
steps_en: Stand in the walker, hands on the grips.
Let go one hand, then the other.
Then both, keeping balance.

exercises.en: Mini squats towards a chair, holding a walker
steps_en: Stand in the walker, chair behind you.
Start to sit, stopping before the seat.
Stand up again.

exercises.en: Sit to stand with arms crossed, then holding a walker
steps_en: Sit at the front of the chair, arms crossed.
Lean forward and stand up.
Hold the walker, then sit back down.

exercises.en: Sit to stand pushing up with the hands, then holding a walker
steps_en: Sit, hands on the seat, walker in front.
Push up and stand, then hold the walker.
Reach back for the seat and sit.

exercises.en: Throw and catch a ball against a wall, standing
steps_en: Stand facing a wall, ball at the chest.
Throw it at the wall.
Catch it as it comes back.

exercises.en: Throw and catch a ball against a wall in tandem stance
steps_en: Stand one foot in front of the other.
Throw the ball at the wall.
Catch it, keeping balance.

exercises.en: Throw and catch a ball against a wall on one leg
steps_en: Stand on one leg facing a wall.
Throw the ball at the wall.
Catch it, keeping balance.

exercises.en: Throw and catch a ball against a wall standing on an upturned BOSU
steps_en: Stand on the flat side of a BOSU.
Throw the ball at the wall.
Catch it, keeping the platform level.

exercises.en: Throw and catch a ball against a wall, sitting on an exercise ball
steps_en: Sit on the exercise ball, feet on the floor.
Throw the ball at the wall.
Catch it, back straight.

exercises.en: Squat, then throw and catch a ball against a wall, on an upturned BOSU
steps_en: Stand on the flat side of a BOSU.
Squat, then throw the ball as you rise.
Catch it and squat again.

exercises.en: Rotational throw of a ball against a wall, kneeling
steps_en: Kneel facing a wall, ball in both hands.
Turn and take the ball to one side.
Throw it at the wall and catch it.

exercises.en: Side rotational throw of a ball against a wall, half kneeling
steps_en: Half kneel side-on to a wall.
Turn away, taking the ball back.
Throw it sideways at the wall and catch it.

exercises.en: Bounce a ball on the floor and catch it, standing
steps_en: Stand, ball in both hands.
Bounce it on the floor in front.
Catch it.

exercises.en: Bounce a ball on the floor and catch it, tandem stance
steps_en: Stand one foot in front of the other.
Bounce the ball on the floor.
Catch it, keeping balance.

exercises.en: Bounce a ball on the floor and catch it, on one leg
steps_en: Stand on one leg, ball in both hands.
Bounce it on the floor.
Catch it.

exercises.en: Toss a ball up and catch it, standing on a wobble cushion
steps_en: Stand on a wobble cushion, ball in front.
Toss it up a little.
Catch it.

exercises.en: Toss a ball up and follow it with the eyes, standing
steps_en: Stand, ball in both hands.
Toss it up, following it with the eyes.
Catch it.

exercises.en: Pass a ball round the waist standing on one leg
steps_en: Stand on one leg, ball in front.
Pass it round the waist, hand to hand.
Switch direction.

exercises.en: Pass a ball round the waist in tandem stance on a foam pad
steps_en: Stand on a foam pad, one foot in front of the other.
Pass the ball round the waist.
Switch direction.

exercises.en: Pass a ball round the waist, sitting on an exercise ball
steps_en: Sit on the exercise ball, feet on the floor.
Pass a ball round the waist.
Switch direction.

exercises.en: Roll a ball under one foot forward, back and to the side, balancing on the other leg
steps_en: Stand on one leg, other foot on a ball.
Roll it forward and back.
Then out to the side.

exercises.en: Roll a ball under one foot in a circle round the standing leg
steps_en: Stand on one leg, other foot on a ball.
Roll the ball in a circle round the standing leg.
Switch direction.

exercises.en: Roll a tennis ball under the sole, sitting
steps_en: Sit, tennis ball under the sole.
Roll it from heel to toes.
Press as much as is comfortable.

exercises.en: Calf release rolling the leg over a tennis ball, sitting
steps_en: Sit, hands behind, tennis ball under the calf.
Slide the leg forward and back over it.
Keep the pressure comfortable.

exercises.en: Press a ball into the wall with one hand, reaching the shoulder forward
steps_en: One hand on a ball against the wall.
Push the shoulder forward into the ball.
Hold, then relax.

exercises.en: Roll a ball on the wall in small circles with one hand
steps_en: One hand on a ball against the wall.
Roll it in small circles.
Keep the shoulder steady.

exercises.en: Roll a ball up the wall with one hand, raising the arm
steps_en: Face the wall, hand on a ball at chest height.
Roll the ball up the wall.
Bring it back down.

exercises.en: Short squat squeezing a ball between the knees
steps_en: Stand, ball between the knees, hands on the hips.
Squat to about 45 degrees, squeezing the ball.
Stand up.

exercises.en: Squeeze a ball between the knees, lying on the back
steps_en: Lie on your back, ball between the knees.
Squeeze it, bringing the thighs together.
Hold, then relax.

exercises.en: Squeeze a ball between the knees and straighten one leg, lying on the back
steps_en: Lie on your back, ball between the knees.
Squeeze and straighten one leg.
Lower it slowly.

exercises.en: Lumbar rotation with a ball between the knees and a ball held up, lying on the back
steps_en: Lie on your back, ball between the knees, ball held up.
Lower both knees to one side.
Return and switch.

exercises.en: Oblique crunch reaching a ball to the side, lying on the back
steps_en: Lie on your back, ball at the chest.
Curl up, reaching the ball to one side.
Lower and switch.

exercises.en: Trunk rotation holding a ball out in front, sitting with legs straight
steps_en: Sit, legs straight, ball held out in front.
Turn the trunk to one side.
Return and switch.

exercises.en: Squat and turn the trunk to each side, holding a ball
steps_en: Stand, ball at the chest.
Squat, then turn to each side.
Stand up.

exercises.en: Touch a ball to the floor, then squat deep lifting it overhead
steps_en: Stand, ball in front.
Bend to touch the ball to the floor.
Squat deep, lifting it overhead.

exercises.en: Roll a ball up overhead with the top arm, lying on the side
steps_en: Lie on your side, top hand on a ball in front.
Roll the ball up overhead.
Bring it back.

exercises.en: Draw the shoulder blade back with the top hand on a ball, lying on the side
steps_en: Lie on your side, top hand on a ball.
Draw the shoulder blade back.
Hold, then relax.

exercises.en: Kick a ball against a wall and stop it, balancing on one leg
steps_en: Stand on one leg facing a wall, ball at the foot.
Kick it gently at the wall.
Stop it with the foot.

exercises.en: Walk bouncing a ball on the floor to the side opposite the stepping leg
steps_en: Walk holding a ball.
At each step bounce it on the opposite side.
Catch it and go on.

exercises.en: Tandem walk bouncing a ball on the floor at each step
steps_en: Walk heel to toe, ball in both hands.
Bounce it at each step.
Catch it and go on.

exercises.en: Tandem walk tossing a ball up at each step
steps_en: Walk heel to toe, ball in front.
Toss it up at each step.
Catch it and go on.

exercises.en: Walk slowly passing a ball round the waist
steps_en: Walk slowly.
Pass a ball round the waist, hand to hand.
Keep a steady pace.

exercises.en: Press the sole into a ball against a wall, knee slightly bent, sitting
steps_en: Sit, knee slightly bent, sole on a ball at the wall.
Press the ball with the sole.
Hold, then relax.

exercises.en: Press the sole into a ball against a wall, knee straight, sitting
steps_en: Sit, leg straight, sole on a ball at the wall.
Press the ball with the sole.
Hold, then relax.

exercises.en: Press the outside of the foot into a ball against a wall, sitting
steps_en: Sit, leg straight, ball between the outer foot and a wall.
Press the outside of the foot into it.
Hold, then relax.

exercises.en: Press the inside of the foot into a ball against a wall, sitting
steps_en: Sit, leg straight, ball between the inner foot and a wall.
Press the inside of the foot into it.
Hold, then relax.

exercises.en: Press the hand down into a ball, lying on the back
steps_en: Lie on your back, hand on a ball.
Press the arm down into the ball.
Hold, then relax.

exercises.en: Press the back of the knee down into a soft ball, lying on the back
steps_en: Lie on your back, soft ball under the knee.
Press the knee down, tightening the thigh.
Hold, then relax.

exercises.en: Ankle pumps with the legs up on pillows, lying on the back
steps_en: Lie on your back, legs up on pillows.
Point the feet, then pull them up.
Keep a slow rhythm.

exercises.en: One leg up on pillows above the heart, lying on the back
steps_en: Lie on your back, one leg up on pillows.
Keep the leg relaxed, foot above the heart.
Move the ankle gently.

exercises.en: Arm up on pillows, lying on the back
steps_en: Lie on your back, arm up on pillows.
Hand higher than the elbow.
Bend and straighten the elbow gently.

exercises.en: Relaxed lying on the stomach, head turned to the side
steps_en: Lie on your stomach, face turned to one side.
Arms relaxed by the body.
Breathe slowly.

exercises.en: Shoulder rotation out and in, elbow bent on a pillow, lying on the back
steps_en: Lie on your back, elbow bent on a pillow.
Turn the forearm out, then in.
Keep the elbow on the pillow.

exercises.en: Isometric shoulder external rotation, the other hand holding the wrist, lying on the back
steps_en: Lie on your back, elbow bent at your side.
Hold the wrist with the other hand.
Try to turn the arm out against it.

exercises.en: Squeeze a pillow between the knees, lying on the back
steps_en: Lie on your back, pillow between the knees.
Squeeze it.
Hold, then relax.

exercises.en: Draw the lower belly in, fingers on the hip bones, lying on the back
steps_en: Lie on your back, fingers on the hip bones.
Draw the lower belly in gently.
Hold, breathing normally.

exercises.en: Knees to the chest, rocking gently side to side, lying on the back
steps_en: Lie on your back, knees to the chest.
Hold the knees.
Rock gently side to side.

exercises.en: Lift the head sideways off the pillow, lying on the side
steps_en: Lie on your side, head on a pillow.
Lift the head towards the top shoulder.
Lower it slowly.

exercises.en: Lift the head and upper trunk sideways, lying on the side
steps_en: Lie on your side, legs slightly bent.
Lift the head and upper trunk sideways.
Lower slowly.

exercises.en: Draw the shoulder blade back, top arm resting on a pillow, lying on the side
steps_en: Lie on your side, top arm resting on a pillow.
Draw the shoulder blade back.
Hold, then relax.

exercises.en: Lift the hands squeezing the shoulder blades, lying on the stomach on a pillow
steps_en: Lie on your stomach, pillow under the trunk.
Lift the hands, squeezing the shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.

exercises.en: Neck side bend, lying on the back with a small pillow
steps_en: Lie on your back, small pillow under the head.
Tilt the ear towards the shoulder.
Return and switch.

exercises.en: Nod the head with the eyes on the thumb, lying on the back
steps_en: Lie on your back, arm up, eyes on the thumb.
Nod the head up and down.
Keep the eyes on the thumb.

exercises.en: Knee fall out with the trunk propped up on pillows
steps_en: Lie propped up on pillows, knees bent.
Let one knee fall out slowly.
Bring it back, pelvis still.

exercises.en: Stand on one leg on a cushion, hand on a chair at the side
steps_en: Stand by a chair, one foot on a cushion.
Lift the other foot.
Hold your balance.

exercises.en: Elbow bends with the arm out to the side resting on pillows, sitting
steps_en: Sit, arm out to the side on pillows on a table.
Bend the elbow, hand to the shoulder.
Straighten it again.

exercises.en: Wrist circles with the elbow bent on pillows, sitting
steps_en: Sit, elbow bent on pillows on a table.
Circle the wrist slowly.
Switch direction.
